scripts.test: yarn has:test && vitest || echo 'No test files found. Skipping test.'
scripts.test:ci: yarn has:test && vitest run --coverage --reporter=default || echo 'No test files found. Skipping test:ci.'
scripts.test:ci:junit: yarn has:test && vitest run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=junit || echo 'No test files found. Skipping test:ci:junit.'
